title: Work good
text: Work good. I always forget that with silicone you must always put something under it to move them. Lol so I put them on a thin small cutting board to move to the freezer and I keep it under them so I can get them out. I like the large square ones because they stay longer in my drinks. The little square ones are so easy to get out.. These are very nice shapes and easy to use once you get used to them..
